summary: Frontend-only test for PWA installability + Android split-screen / floating-window detection on Try Out. All review-request features validated. One operational note: public/index.html edits (apple-touch-icon link, apple-mobile-web-app-title meta) were NOT reflected in served HTML until frontend was restarted — webpack-dev-server does not pick up index.html template changes via hot reload. After `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` the links/meta appear correctly.

test_results.pwa_manifest: PASS - /manifest.json 200, display:'fullscreen', start_url:'/', scope:'/', icons 192 & 512 present (any + maskable). /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /apple-touch-icon.png all 200.
test_results.service_worker: PASS - /sw.js 200 (install/activate/fetch). navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration() returns active registration with scope '/'.
test_results.html_meta: PASS (after frontend restart) - rendered DOM contains link[rel=manifest] and link[rel=apple-touch-icon] pointing to /apple-touch-icon.png; meta apple-mobile-web-app-capable=yes and apple-mobile-web-app-title=Binara present.
test_results.install_banner_desktop_no_bip: PASS - On 1366x900 desktop UA with no beforeinstallprompt dispatched, [data-testid=install-app-banner] is NOT rendered.
test_results.install_banner_iphone: PASS - With iPhone UA + 390x844, install-app-banner renders. Clicking install-app-button opens [data-testid=ios-install-dialog] containing 3 steps (Safari share → Add to Home Screen (Tambahkan) → Tambah). install-app-dismiss hides banner; sessionStorage.install_banner_hidden='1'.
test_results.install_banner_beforeinstallprompt: PASS - Dispatching custom Event('beforeinstallprompt') with stub prompt()/userChoice via add_init_script → install-app-banner renders on desktop; clicking install-app-button increments stubbed __promptCalled (=1), confirming promptInstall() invoked.
test_results.standalone_mode: PASS - matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') stubbed true → install-app-banner hidden; in exam the [data-testid=pseudo-fullscreen-gate] contains 'Mode Aplikasi aktif' and [data-testid=pseudo-fullscreen-recommend] is NOT rendered.
test_results.split_screen_detection: PASS - On touch/mobile emulation, overriding window.innerWidth/innerHeight to 390x380 (<60% of 390x844 screen) + firing resize → after ~1.2s debounce the [data-testid=tab-warning-dialog] appears, exam-violation-counter increments by exactly 1 (1/5 → 2/5). Clicking tab-warning-continue closes dialog and [data-testid=split-screen-overlay] remains visible while viewport still small. Firing resize again while still shrunk does NOT re-increment (dedupe via inSplit flag). Restoring viewport to 390x844 hides the overlay.
test_results.window_blur_detection: PASS - Stubbing document.hasFocus=()=>false and dispatching window 'blur' → after 1.5s blurTimer fires, counter increments by 1 (2/5 → 3/5) and tab-warning-dialog shows 'Peringatan 3 dari 5'. The reportViolation() 2.5s dedupe prevents double counting with fullscreen exit.
test_results.essay_input_focus_no_violation: PASS - On short-answer question (soal 4, essay-input), focusing the <input> then triggering viewport shrink does NOT fire tab-warning-dialog. typing() guard in isShrunk() correctly ignores split-check when document.activeElement is INPUT.
test_results.regression_from_iteration_28: SPOT-CHECKED - FullscreenGate still shows for desktop needFs=true, PseudoFullscreenGate shows on standalone/iPhone, NoFullscreenNotice bar shows when fsFailed, tab-warning-continue continues the exam. Auto-submit at limit NOT re-exercised in this run to preserve remaining student attempts (verified in iteration_28).

action_items: OPTIONAL/INFRA: public/index.html changes require a frontend process restart (webpack-dev-server does not hot-reload the HTML template). If this template is modified again in future, remind main agent to `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`.
OPTIONAL: /sw.js currently has an empty fetch handler — fine for installability but offers no offline support for the exam. Not required by spec, just noting.
critical_code_review_comments: useSplitScreenGuard.isShrunk(): correctly uses Math.max/Math.min of screen.width/height so works in both portrait and landscape; good.
typing() check ignores split while input/textarea/select/contentEditable is focused — this correctly suppresses false-positives on Android soft-keyboard shrink. Good.
reportViolation() dedupe window (2500ms) prevents double counting from near-simultaneous fullscreen-exit + split-detect; verified via rapid consecutive shrink events.
InstallAppBanner uses sessionStorage so banner reappears on new browser session — intentional and matches spec.

pwa.js initPwa() registers service worker on window.load — safe; emits to listeners on bip/appinstalled; `canPromptInstall()` sync + onInstallAvailable listener pattern makes InstallAppBanner react correctly when bip arrives after mount.
